title: Gemini native chat provider
objective: Add AstrBot-compatible Google GenAI chat provider support while keeping provider construction behind ProviderRegistry and runtime typed config.

steps.description: Study AstrBot ProviderGoogleGenAI registration, request mapping, image handling, and response finish reason behavior.
Implement GeminiConfig and GeminiProvider behind the ChatProvider trait.
Register googlegenai_chat_completion in ProviderRegistry and expose runtime config construction.
Add integration tests for text/system/context, data URL image content, safety and policy finish reasons, HTTP error mapping, registry registration, and runtime config mapping.
Run formatting, workspace tests, clippy, and CLI smoke verification.
